d:
A celestial humanoid species with a muscular build and a face of serene maturity. The hair is a short, neat crop of platinum white, and the eyes are calm and glowing with a soft gold light. The outfit consists of a white tunic with gold armor plates and a long, flowing cape of brilliant white. The design features two large, feathered white wings on the back and a gold halo hovering above the head. 5 fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
